## 2. THE THREE THINGS THAT MATTER MOST

**(a) The negative control was the agonist.** `NEG_nonbinder` is 81% mature human EGF (43/53
residues verbatim, all six cysteines in order). Every bar in this project was calibrated
against it. Per PK it is now **activity-unknown**, not "a binder" — the similarity stops us
calling it a nonbinder but does not establish it retains EGF's affinity. The 0.1493/0.2218
hard gates are **RETIRED**; affinity is a continuous reported column with an
`affinity_above_null` flag. `MIN_AFFINITY = None` in `bin/emit_submission_csv.py`.
EGF's own measured KD on this platform is **55 nM median** (not the ~2 nM I wrote to PK).

**(b) BindCraft beats BoltzGen on every axis, and we gave it 11 invocations vs 1,944 designs.**
  dual-species binding   50% vs 3.5%
  Potts pH distribution  median +1.60 vs +2.90
  QC                     GRAVY -0.52..-1.37 (all clean) vs +0.10..+0.24
  71 BindCraft designs were recovered off the Modal volume on Oct 4 having never been scored;
  18 of them switch AND bind both species. Rank 3 came from that recovery.
  `bin/bindcraft-sync.sh` now pulls everything off the volume. RUN IT AFTER EVERY BindCraft JOB.

**(c) One mutation converts a binder into a switch, and it now replicates four times.**
First result: `d2c_mpnn13` WT = 0.70x; S88D = 4.57x over 5 poses; knock the Asp back to Ala
= 0.72x. Knockout effect **+5.20 pKa units**, the largest in the project.
Then on 2026-10-04 at 2:50 PM the full refold sweep surfaced the `sd2` arm, never scored:
**four matched WT/S15D pairs on the best-binding BindCraft backbone** (`d3acid_l65_s831683`),
four independent MPNN sequences, all four moving the same direction at no affinity cost:

    sequence   WT ratio -> S15D ratio    hu (WT -> S15D)      mo (WT -> S15D)
    mpnn6         3.85  ->  5.40         0.789 -> 0.780       0.769 -> 0.751
    mpnn8         3.15  ->  5.46         0.821 -> 0.776       0.807 -> 0.764
    mpnn9         3.52  ->  5.43         0.783 -> 0.803       0.782 -> 0.803
    mpnn19        3.68  ->  5.43         0.828 -> 0.808       0.815 -> 0.786

These are the four highest-affinity designs in the project AND near the highest switch, and
`bc_s831683_mpnn9_WT` is submitted alongside its S15D so the effect is MEASURED, not predicted.
All five clear novelty at Level 3 on their own refold structures (`analysis/01-egfr/novelty_s15d.tsv`),
all five are clean on `bin/express_qc.py` with no cysteine.

## 3. DECISIONS ALREADY MADE — do not relitigate

- **One submission, made LATE** (target Mon evening). Not three. Mooted the 24h-cooldown rule.
- **Mouse dropped as a tier-2 sort key.** Anthropic says mouse is measured at pH 7.4 only, so a
  design that switches off at 7.4 has an undefined mouse/human ratio. Tier 2 sorts by human.
  The meaningful mouse criterion is whether the switching histidine is conserved (H433 yes).
- **Mosaic stays gated** for problems 2-5; Proton-PottsMPNN took over its rationale.
- **Git remote deferred to submission time.** IT IS A REQUIRED DELIVERABLE AND DOES NOT EXIST.
- **S88D replaces its parent** `d2c_mpnn13` (99.3% identical); mpnn11 is one of 12 sequences on
  one backbone = **one sequence family, one slot**.

## 4. OPEN DECISIONS FOR HARISH

1. **Shrink the submission?** 10 of 20 rows are null-value padding. PK and our own STATUS.md
   both favour fewer honest rows. The top 10 all stand on measurements.
2. **Four S15D slots on one backbone.** Ranks 1-4 are four MPNN sequences on
   `d3acid_l65_s831683`, plus its matched WT at rank 9 and `mpnn11` at rank 8 — six of twenty
   slots on one backbone. That buys wet-lab replication of the only causal result we have, at
   the cost of diversity. Defensible either way; it is a call, not an oversight.
3. **Tier-2 sort key contradicts a recorded decision.** Section 3 says tier 2 sorts by HUMAN
   (mouse is measured at pH 7.4 only, so a switched-off design has no defined mouse ratio).
   `rank_key` in `bin/emit_submission_csv.py` sorts BOTH tiers by `(-mo, -hu)`. It changes which
   null-value rows pad the tail — `rimA01_r05` (hu 0.296) and `bg02_r01` (hu 0.247) are dropped
   in favour of `rimA02_r01` (hu 0.010) and `d2d_mpnn5` (hu 0.012). Moot if the submission shrinks.
   NOT changed unilaterally.
4. **`bg04_r03` (now rank 11)** re-pooled from 2.499 to **1.937** and is still 0.0000/0.0000 on
   both species with 3 QC flags incl. an unpaired cysteine. Nothing supports it.
5. **`h370_020_vhh` carries format risk.** It clears at antibody-rule Level **4** — the only
   de-novo design in the set — but under the general-protein rule it is Level 2 (TM 0.914) and
   would be auto-rejected at upload. Same risk applies to `rimA02_d3_rimA_14_vhh` (general-rule
   Level 1). If Adaptyv's ANARCI does not call them antibodies, those two rows fail the gate.
   **Upload EARLY enough to resubmit** rather than at the wire.

## 5. TOOLING YOU WILL NEED

    bin/ph_gate_all.py          pH gate, all designs, generator poses (1,944 rows)
    bin/ph_gate_refolds.py      pH gate on ESMFold2 refolds -- run it on ALL 131 run dirs
    bin/ph_pool_by_sequence.py  ONE ratio per MOLECULE, pooled by binder sequence
    bin/master_rank.py          pH + affinity joined BY SEQUENCE -- the single ranking table
    bin/sync_submission_from_master.py   re-points submission ratios at the pooled values
    bin/antibody_novelty.py     Adaptyv's ANTIBODY novelty branch (CDRH3); --selftest
    bin/express_qc.py           cell-free expression liabilities (OVERWRITES express_qc.tsv)
    bin/instrument_v2.py        ipSAE_min, v1 max / v2 median over seeds
    bin/emit_submission_csv.py  builds the CSV; selftest must pass
    bin/check_discards.py       hard gate: nothing unmeasured may outrank a submitted design
    bin/bindcraft-sync.sh       pull BindCraft output off the Modal volume
    bin/novelty_gate.py         FOLDSEEK=tools/foldseek/bin/foldseek ... --db tools/fsdb/pdb

**Proton-PottsMPNN** (third pH predictor, local CPU):
    HBPLUS_PATH=/tmp/HBPLUS/hbplus/hbplus DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/lib \
      /tmp/ProtonPottsMPNN/.venv/bin/python /tmp/ppm_batch.py <list.txt> <out.csv>
  `/tmp` IS NOT PERSISTENT. Rebuild: clone github.com/christian-creator/ProtonPottsMPNN,
  `./install.sh`, and build HBPLUS from github.com/RomanLas/HBPLUS (`make` in `hbplus/`).

**Standing traps, all of which have bitten:**
  - zsh does NOT word-split unquoted variables (broke 3 scripts)
  - chain order is NOT consistent: 29 of 69 run dirs have the TARGET in chain A. Use
    `ph_gate_all.orient()`. This has broken 3 separate analyses.
  - construct numbering differs: crop H433=123, d3 H433=99, ECD H433=409. UniProt = PDB + 24.
  - `python3` has gemmi+propka; `.venv` has numpy but NOT gemmi
  - ProcessPoolExecutor cannot fork from a heredoc -- write a real .py file
  - score-esmfold2.sh cd's into biomodals/, so OUT_DIR must start `../`
  - **names are not identities.** The same molecule appears under up to 3 run names
    (`gap_`/`cons_gap_`/`gc_` prefixes), so a name-keyed `n` read 1 when 11 poses existed and
    the OPTIMISTIC single pose became the headline. Join on the binder SEQUENCE. This has now
    broken 5 analyses; `master_rank.py` exists so it cannot happen a sixth time.
  - novelty: **high structural similarity ALONE (TM >= 0.80) is Level 2**, with no sequence
    condition. Missing that clause rejected 109 of 233 designs that actually clear, including
    the entire BindCraft pool, and produced the bogus "0/120 pass novelty" result.
